title: Research: Pareto-selected R420 block 6 circuit saves 14 ADDs (no new kappa)
body:
## Result

This finite circuit contribution replaces phase-B block 6 of eumemic's retained PR543 R420 word, frame 548 (`B[417:471]`), with a 47-XOR circuit instead of 54. Rebuilding the literal inverse cleanup reduces the complete local word from 26,916 to 26,902 common-frame scalar ADDs. All 660 columns, the H1-H5 interface, nine COPY/ERASE pairs, paid histogram, rank mass 5,112, and hosted `c` values are preserved. **No new κ is claimed; the current selected result is unchanged.**

## Bounded search

The exact upstream randomized pivoted-LU sampler was run for 20,000 candidates on this block, with its existing seed rule `7 * block_index = 42`. This replay changes the selector to retain the gate-count/positive-norm Pareto frontier and choose the fewest gates at or below the baseline norm. All 20,000 samples were valid; the observed nondominated pairs are `(47, 5477)` and `(48, 4025)`, against baseline `(54, 5513)`. This is a result about that fixed sample only, not a circuit minimum or an all-class search.

## Reproduction and verification

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r420-block6-budgeted-lu/verify.py
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_R420_BLOCK6_BUDGETED_LU baseline=54 candidate=47 local_ADDs=26916->26902
CANDIDATE_SHA256 492409b42341db62be992b1ed2d402d6aa9d4dacbb64e2fe49a496afe05ed286
```

The exact base is `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`; source hashes and Git blobs are in `SOURCES.json`. The adapted full historical R420 pipeline passed, including native 5/9/11-stage checks, both hosted pricing paths, and R480/R489 controls. Its two narrow changes to `verify.sh` and the exact receipts are described in `README.md` and `VALIDATION.json`.

The current selection remains κ=`0.001672660197076918` from PR1094's reviewed chain, with PR589 on PR555's punctured R439 word supplying the bit side. The R420 word is a separate historical construction. Credit eumemic and the retained PR543/370/493 lineage, plus distinct concurrent R420 block work by yongjae321, x0hu, Yuzhou Wang, Jerry Lin, and commdata2338. Prepared for @1337isnot1337 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No independent human review or complete multiplication proof is claimed.
